evidence.quote: Microstructure and Properties of Aluminum-Containing Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
Microstructure and Properties of Aluminum-Containing Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
The addition of Al to the refractory HEAs considered in this work has produced several beneficial effects over the earlier reported refractory HEAs.
The phase composition, microstructure, and properties of six new refractory high-entropy alloys are reported.
